title: Image-only CT trace audit: lesion acceptance and instance convention precede event errors
claim: Astra deliberately grouped connected abdominal portions and covered most voxels of all three abdominal baseline GT instances, but omitted a separate reference focus. Sol rejected its candidates and deliberately submitted empty masks after inspecting views containing GT regions. Confluence wording plausibly affects Astra instance/event interpretation; neither output isolates event reasoning capability.
limitations: One fresh attempt per model on one selected pair; post-hoc mechanism analysis is not causal attribution from controlled ablations.
Expert lesion boundary and malignancy disputes remain under review; connectivity alone is not confluence.
Neither output detects a complete reference event group.
Follow-up reconstruction differs from saved mask at one voxel; saved original masks and frozen scores remain authoritative.
Image delivery and coverage do not establish attention to each lesion.
